verdict.rationale: Vast.ai is a GPU cloud marketplace/infrastructure platform (CLI, API, SDK, instance rental) — it is not itself an agentic assistant with a runtime that would consume external tools via MCP. The evidence shows the reverse relationship: an 'agent skill' lets AI coding assistants drive Vast.ai (vast-ai-docs-4/23/39), which is Vast.ai being used as a tool by other agents, not Vast.ai acting as an MCP client. This axis does not apply to this product category.
